title: Harsh whole-system review of the governed research stack
topic: Evaluate the current research control plane, researcher harness, governance model, and supervised improvement loop as a real system rather than a promising prototype.
question: What is structurally weak, operationally brittle, overdesigned, missing, or misleading in the governed research system as currently built, and what must be stabilized before further expansion?
success_condition: Produce a harsh system-level assessment, rank the most important stabilization actions, identify what should not be built next, and state whether the system should stabilize, refactor, or expand.
self_review_focus: Do not reward artifact volume, naming neatness, or governance complexity. Prefer identifying weak assumptions, manual choke points, low-signal machinery, and places where the system appears more mature than it is.
constraints: Assume the current architecture may be wrong in important ways.
Prefer stabilization and simplification candidates over expansion work.
Identify places where the operator is still compensating manually.
Penalize solutions that add complexity without improving decision quality.
Treat governance overhead as a cost, not an automatic virtue.
Distinguish between what is operational today and what is only scaffolded.

hypotheses.statement: The system is strong on control surfaces and artifact generation but still weak on actual research quality control, portfolio decision-making, and operator simplicity.
hypotheses.expected_outcome: The top-ranked follow-ups will favor stabilization, simplification, and stronger evaluation loops over new feature surfaces.
hypotheses.falsifiable_condition: The strongest evidence shows the system is already operationally mature and the best next work is expansion rather than stabilization.

hypotheses.statement: Some current machinery creates the appearance of rigor without yet delivering enough decision-quality improvement to justify its maintenance cost.
hypotheses.expected_outcome: The review will identify at least one area to simplify, collapse, or defer.
hypotheses.falsifiable_condition: Every major mechanism is shown to materially improve reliability, promotion quality, or operator leverage.

required_sources.title: Local platform control-plane contracts and public orchestration docs
Local researcher-harness contracts and runtime docs

options.summary: Pause major expansion and focus on strengthening the current loop, evaluation, and operator workflow.
Continue adding capabilities while fixing only the highest-friction weaknesses.
risks: can bury structural weaknesses under more surface area

options.summary: Rework major control-plane or researcher assumptions before continuing.
